focused_candidate_evidence.environment: Linux arm64, Go 1.26.8; local controlled HTTP fixture, real in-process Core HTTPS/WebSocket server, enrolled Agent process, SQLite; development lease timeout 8s with the production Agent heartbeat cadence.
focused_candidate_evidence.result: HTTP 503 results 1–3 moved the Core probe to unhealthy; result 4 was 204 and kept unhealthy with one consecutive success; result 5 was 204 and restored healthy. Canceling the Agent led the real Core lease path to mark the node offline and the probe unknown/node_offline, clear counters, write one offline history row, and leave no pending run. Restarting the same enrolled Agent produced two fresh 204 results and restored healthy.
focused_candidate_evidence.normative_status_note: Candidate loopback evidence only; S14-04 and S14-05 remain NOT_READY pending the plan-required independent node/environment evidence.
